description: Notification sent to admin users when a new incident is logged in the First Aid Portal.
subject: First Aid Incident Reported — $reference ($severity)
body:
A new first aid incident has been logged in the First Aid Portal and requires your attention.

Incident Details:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Reference:      $reference
Incident Type:  $incident_type
Severity:       $severity
Location:       $location
Reported:       $submitted_at
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Reported by:
  Name:    $reporter_name
  ID:      $reporter_id
  Account: $reporter_user
  Phone:   $phone

What happened:
$description

Please review this incident in the First Aid Portal and ensure an appropriate response and any required follow-up are actioned.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
This is an automated notification from the University First Aid Portal. Please do not reply to this email.
